bio: After training at the Paul Bocuse Institute and a number of noteworthy spells in top establishments, such as Troisgros, youthful Carla Kirsch, who hails from Veracruz in Mexico, has settled in the Croix-Rousse district. The signature here is clearly Mexican from the décor, which features old rafters with splashes of colour, to the food, which Carla joyfully crafts using top-notch seasonal ingredients (sweet corn in the starter and chili peppers in the dessert). The menu changes monthly and the beverages include a few Mexican wines as well as tequilas and mezcals....
